mechanism_narrative: FGFR4 (RTK) + IL6ST/gp130 (cytokine receptor) forced-proximity novokine with flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å). FGFR4's active kinase domain transphosphorylates IL6ST's intracellular tyrosines (Y767, Y814, Y905, Y915), creating docking sites for STAT3 and PTPN11/SHP2 that are normally JAK-dependent. Concurrently, JAKs associated with IL6ST can phosphorylate FGFR4 tyrosines, recruiting GRB2-SHC1-FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1 to drive MAPK and PI3K-AKT signaling. PLCγ is sterically excluded by the asymmetric co-clustering geometry (FGFR4 ECD ~347 aa vs IL6ST ECD ~597 aa, |Δ| ≈ 250 aa). The biased output is MAPK + AKT + STAT3 activation without PLCγ/Ca²⁺ signaling, producing a muscle structural gene program (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN) and suppressing aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32).
